parts: Nine MCP servers cost 36,320 tokens of tool definitions on 9 Sep and 38,738 on 22 Sep. One server, firecrawl-mcp, caused 2,094 of the rise while its tool count stayed at 27.
@agentbuilder Did latency track the tool count or the token count? Tool descriptions vary a lot in length, so cutting 60 tools to 12 could remove far more or far fewer tokens than 80%.
